ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Korean Commercial Act (Act No. 1000, as amended), Articles 23, 25 and 287-2 through 287-35; Act on Reporting and Use of Specific Financial Transaction Information (Act No. 10617, as amended), Articles 2, 5-2 and 8-2 and its Enforcement Decree, Article 3; Act on the Establishment and Operation of Korea Financial Intelligence Unit, Articles 6 and 7; Foreign Investment Promotion Act, Articles 5 and 26; Personal Information Protection Act, Article 24-3; FATF International Standards on Combating Money Laundering and the Financing of Terrorism and Proliferation.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation (Certificate of Registered Corporate Particulars)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Registry Office of the competent Korean District Court; Supreme Court of Korea Registration System
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Court-issued certified copy -> Apostille by the Korean Ministry of Foreign Affairs for Hague Apostille Convention states. For non-member states: court-issued certified copy -> Korean MOFA authentication -> Consular legalization by the destination state's embassy or consulate in Korea. Apostille and consular legalization are parallel and mutually exclusive; they must never be chained.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing (Certificate of Current Registered Particulars and No Dissolution)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Registry Office of the competent Korean District Court (obtained immediately after incorporation registration)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Court-issued certified copy -> Korean MOFA Apostille for Apostille Convention states. Non-member states: court-issued certified copy -> Korean MOFA authentication -> Consular legalization by destination-state consulate in Korea.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board Resolution or Power of Attorney authorizing pre-incorporation filings, bank account opening and execution of documents
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Initial incorporators / first board of directors of Yuhan Hoesa
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization of the executing signatures by a Korean notary public -> Korean MOFA Apostille for member states. Non-member states: notarization -> Korean MOFA authentication -> destination-state consular legalization in Korea. Apostille and consular legalization are alternative paths only.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Articles of Association (Articles of Incorporation) of Yuhan Hoesa
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: All founding members and a Korean notary public
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Execution before a Korean notary public -> Apostille by Korean MOFA for Apostille states. Non-member states: notarization -> Korean MOFA authentication -> consular legalization at the destination state's embassy in Korea. Never combine apostille with consular legalization.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank Reference Letter and Good Standing from a depository bank
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Issuing commercial bank in the investor's jurisdiction or in Korea
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: If issued in Korea: bank officer signature notarized by Korean notary -> Korean MOFA Apostille for member states or MOFA authentication plus destination consulate legalization for non-member states. If issued abroad: notarization in the country of origin -> Apostille by that country's competent authority for member states or consular legalization by the Korean embassy or consulate in that country for non-member states.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: UBO Declaration and Source of Funds Statement
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: All ultimate beneficial owners; notarized before a Korean notary public
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization of the declaration -> Korean MOFA Apostille for member states. Non-member states: notarization -> Korean MOFA authentication -> Consular legalization by destination-state consulate in Korea. This path is exclusive of apostille.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: All directors, shareholders, beneficial owners, officers, and major counterparties of Yuhan Hoesa must be screened before filing against: (i) the UN Security Council Consolidated Sanctions List; (ii) OFAC SDN and non-SDN sanctions lists; (iii) the EU consolidated financial sanctions list; (iv) Korean Government financial sanctions and KoFIU advisories; (v) FATF high-risk jurisdiction lists; and (vi) local court and regulatory enforcement records. PEP status must be identified for all domestic and foreign politically exposed persons, including family members and close associates. Any match requires enhanced due diligence, source-of-wealth and source-of-funds verification, senior-management approval, and, if warranted, a suspicious transaction report to KoFIU.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Internet Registration Office (IROS) of the Supreme Court of Korea (iros.go.kr) and the Korean Court Registration Information System
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The official trade name of a Korean limited liability company must be in Hangul. English may appear only as a parallel registered foreign trade name; it cannot replace the Hangul name. The four-tier naming convention is: (1) distinctive identification term; (2) principal business descriptor for assembly and sale of interactive AI pet robots; (3) mandatory legal form suffix 'Yuhan Hoesa'; and (4) optional parallel English transliteration. The registry will reject a name that is identical or confusingly similar to an existing company in the same city carrying on the same business.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the registry issues written grounds. The applicant may either correct and re-file through IROS, or file an immediate appeal to the competent district court under the Non-Contentious Case Litigation Procedure Act within two weeks of service of the rejection notice. The appeal must attach the rejection notice, the corrected proposed name, and a comparative name search. If dismissed, a further appeal to the Seoul High Court may be available. A fictitious trade name reservation cannot be extended; after lapse, a fresh application may be filed if the name remains available.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A standalone virtual office or commercial mailbox is not statutorily forbidden for registration, but it is operationally rejected by most Korean commercial banks for corporate account opening and by the National Tax Service for VAT invoicing and corporate tax compliance in the assembly, distribution and cross-border e-commerce industry. A physical serviced office with a lease

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Commercial Act of the Republic of Korea (Act No. 1000, as amended), Part VI on Limited Liability Companies (Yuhan Hoesa), Article 543 et seq., together with the Enforcement Rules on the Registration of Commercial Entities.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registry Office under the Supreme Court of the Republic of Korea; operationally, the Seoul Central District Court Registry Office or the registry office having territorial jurisdiction over the Companys registered office address.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Certificate of Incorporation registration application form and the notarized Articles of Incorporation (Jeonggwan), filed under the Commercial Act and the Non-Litigation Case Procedure Act.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital is required for a Yuhan Hoesa under the Commercial Act. Where initial capital is expressed in the Articles of Incorporation, the full subscription amount must be deposited in a restricted corporate bank account in the Republic of Korea before the incorporation registration is submitted, and the deposited funds remain blocked until the registry has issued the certificate of incorporation. In-kind contributions require an independent appraiser valuation report. If no capital is declared, no deposit requirement applies.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: IN THE MATTER OF THE INCORPORATION OF YUHAN HOESA (THE COMPANY), A LIMITED LIABILITY COMPANY ORGANIZED UNDER THE COMMERCIAL ACT OF THE REPUBLIC OF KOREA: WHEREAS, the founding shareholders have resolved to subscribe for the entire initial capital of the Company, consisting of one hundred and fifty thousand capital units with a par value of KRW 10,000 each, representing an aggregate subscription amount of KRW 1,500,000,000; WHEREAS, the initial subscribed capital must be deposited in a domestic bank prior to registration and must remain restricted until the certificate of incorporation is issued; WHEREAS, the registered office of the Company shall be established at the address set forth in the Articles of Incorporation, and the Company shall post a company nameplate and file all changes of address with the competent registry office; WHEREAS, it is necessary to appoint the statutory officers of the Company and to authorize the opening of banking facilities for the daily business of the Company; NOW THEREFORE, BE IT RESOLVED AS FOLLOWS: FIRST, that the subscriptions for the Companys capital units recited in the Preambles be and they are hereby ratified, accepted, and confirmed in full; SECOND, that the representative director be and he or she on behalf of the Company is hereby expressly authorized to open a demand deposit account at a commercial bank in the Republic of Korea, to execute all bank forms, resolutions, and mandates in the name of the Company, and to give payment orders for operating expenses, supplier liabilities, and statutory contributions; THIRD, that the registered office of the Company be and it is hereby adopted as the address specified in the Articles of Incorporation, and that the representative director is instructed to deliver the registration certificate to the registry office and to notify any change of address within fourteen days after the change; FOURTH, that the following statutory officers be and they are hereby appointed: one representative director, one auditor, and such other officers as may be required by the Commercial Act of the Republic of Korea; each officer assumes office upon execution of this Resolution and shall be registered with the court registry office without delay; FIFTH, that the representative director and any two directors be authorized jointly to negotiate, sign, and deliver all documents required for the issuance of debt instruments, guarantees, and procurement contracts in the ordinary course of the Companys robotics assembly business; SIXTH, that this Resolution may be acted upon without further consent other than the statutory conditions set forth in the Commercial Act, and that no person dealing with the Company shall be required to verify the scope of the authority hereby granted; SEVENTH, that all lawful acts of the promoters and officers performed after the date of the certificate of incorporation and before the execution and adoption of this Resolution are hereby ratified and approved.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notarization of Korean-Language Articles of Incorporation and Name Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public under the Notary Act, and name review with the Supreme Court Registry Office electronic system
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the Korean-language Articles of Incorporation containing the company name Yuhan Hoesa, the exact registered office address, the total number of capital units, the par value and type of contributions, the business purpose which shall include the research, development, assembly, testing, and sale of interactive AI companion pet robots, the appointment of the initial representative director and auditor, and the rules of shareholder meetings. The promoters must verify that the proposed name is not identical to an existing registered business name in the Korean court registry database before signing. All founding shareholders must sign the document, and the signature of each shareholder must be notarized by a licensed Korean notary public, who will confirm that the signatories appeared personally and that the contents of the articles are accurate. At least three original notarized copies should be produced for subsequent use at the bank, the court registry, and the tax office.
required_dossiers: Notarized Korean-language Articles of Incorporation
Passport or foreign-investor identification copies of all promoters
Corporate seal certificate and individual signature certificates of the initial directors
Power of attorney if filing through an agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary refuses to certify, the promoters shall correct the legal translation or capital clauses and re-submit to the same notary or to another notary within three business days; if the name is rejected, a second-choice corporate name shall be filed through the same electronic system.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Opening of Temporary Capital Subscription Account and Deposit of Subscribed Cash Capital
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed commercial bank in Korea selected by the representative director
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After the Articles are notarized, the Company must open a provisional subscription deposit account in the name of Yuhan Hoesa at a licensed commercial bank in the Republic of Korea and deposit the full amount of cash capital stated in the Articles. Although the Commercial Act imposes no minimum capital, the subscribed amount must be fully paid before registration. The bank will issue a certificate of deposit or balance confirmation addressed to the court registry office. If any capital contribution is made in kind, such as patents, industrial designs, or machinery, the promoters must obtain an independent appraiser valuation report and attach a written description of the in-kind property exchanged for capital units. The deposit account remains restricted until the certificate of incorporation is issued; after registration the same bank will convert the relationship into an ordinary operating current account.
required_dossiers: Notarized Articles of Incorporation
Certificate of capital subscription signed by each promoter
Original bank certificate of restricted capital deposit
Independent appraisal report for any in-kind contribution
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank refuses to open the provisional account because of KYC concerns, the shareholders shall provide renewed identification, proof of source of funds, and a declaration of the intended business, and re-submit the application within five business days with a substitute bank.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Incorporation Registration with the Court of Jurisdiction
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Seoul Central District Court Registry Office or the registry office having territorial jurisdiction over the Companys registered office address
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the application for incorporation registration to the competent court registry office using the prescribed registry form signed and sealed by the representative director. The application must be accompanied by the certificate of deposit, the notarized Articles of Incorporation, the written consents or appointment resolutions of the directors and auditor, and the corporate seal certificate if an impressment seal has been made. The registry will review the legality of the incorporation, including the adequacy of the business purpose, the legality of the office location, and the payment of registration duty and local education tax. When the registry is satisfied, it will assign the registration number, record the company in the commercial register, and issue a certificate of incorporation, at which moment the legal personality of the Company arises.
required_dossiers: Prescribed incorporation registration application form
Notarized Articles of Incorporation
Bank certificate of restricted capital deposit
Record of appointment of representative director, auditor, and other officers
Corporate seal certificate and impressment certificate
Proof of payment of registration duty and education tax
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry issues a corrective notice, the representative director or statutory counsel shall cure the stated deficiency by filing an amended form or supplementary exhibit within ten business days; if the registration is refused, the Company may file an immediate appeal to the competent district court under the Non-Litigation Case Procedure Act.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Business Registration and Tax Identification at the National Tax Service
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: District Tax Office of the National Tax Service having jurisdiction over the registered office address
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within thirty calendar days after receipt of the certificate of incorporation, the representative director must apply for business registration with the district tax office of the National Tax Service. The application must state the corporate registered name, address, business purpose, representative director information, and expected date of commencement. Attach the certificate of incorporation, the Articles of Incorporation, the corporate lease agreement, and the tax-related powers of attorney. After verification and issuance of the Business Registration Certificate with a unique corporate tax number, the Company must register for value added tax if the business is expected to have taxable supplies of merchandise. The tax office will also register the Company for corporate income tax on a fiscal-year basis. If the filing is incomplete, the tax office may return the application or place it in suspension.
required_dossiers: Certificate of incorporation from the court registry
Notarized Articles of Incorporation
Lease agreement for the registered office
Corporate seal certificate and certificate of authorized signature
Tax invoice application and business plan if requested
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the district tax office returns the application, the Company shall file an amended application with all requested attachments within ten business days; if the tax office continues to delay, the Company may apply for an administrative correction under the Framework Act on National Tax.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Bank Activation and Statutory Post-Incorporation Filings
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Commercial bank branch selected by the board and the local employment insurance office where applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Present the certificate of incorporation, corporate seal certificate, business registration certificate, and the pro-forma first board resolution to the commercial bank where the provisional subscription account is held. The bank shall convert the blocked account into an unrestricted corporate operating account and issue debit cards, checks, and online banking credentials to the officers designated in the resolution. Thereafter, the representative director should file the appointment of an auditor with the court registry and register any employees with the local employment insurance and industrial accident compensation insurance offices. For a robotics assembly operation, this step also requires the Company to open a second bank account for customer settlements under the designated payment rails Stripe and credit cards, and to issue internal authority signatures for the finance officer.
required_dossiers: Certificate of incorporation
Business Registration Certificate
Board resolution appointing bank officers and signatories
Corporate seal certificate and director identification
Evidence of factory lease and planned workforce for insurance registration
Bank KYC forms including beneficial ownership statement
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank imposes additional economic-substance due diligence because the ultimate owner is non-resident, the Company shall supply the shareholder register, source-of-funds statements, and organization chart within five business days; if insurance filings are queried, the Company shall amend the wage data through the computerized system and re-file within the statutory deadline.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Korean Agency for Technology and Standards under the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy; local municipal government (Si/Gun/Gu) for factory establishment registration; Korea Testing Certification and Korean Testing and Research Institute as designated consumer-safety certification bodies.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Factory Establishment Registration under the Industrial Cluster Development and Factory Establishment Act; KC Safety Certification for electrical and electronic products under the Electrical Appliances and Consumer Products Safety Control Act; Childrens Product Safety Certification under the Special Act on Safety of Childrens Products.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Environment of the Republic of Korea through the Korea Environment Corporation and the local environmental management office
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Environmental Registration (light environmental review) for a small factory with total floor area under 10,000 square meters and no hazardous chemical process; a Full Environmental Impact Assessment is triggered only if the project is located in a protection zone or if the development area exceeds the statutory small-scale EIA threshold of 10,000 square meters.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater discharge for process water above 20 cubic meters per day must be permitted or reported under the Water Environment Conservation Act with effluent limits of BOD not exceeding 50 mg/L, COD not exceeding 70 mg/L, suspended solids not exceeding 50 mg/L, total nitrogen not exceeding 60 mg/L, and total phosphorus not exceeding 8 mg/L. Volatile organic compound emissions from degreasing and coating are reportable where consumption of organic solvents reaches 5 tonnes per year or more, with a workplace concentration limit of 200 ppm as TLV for the main solvents; hazardous wastes must be stored in compatible leak-proof containers and transported by a licensed waste handler within 30 days, and all manifests shall be retained for five years.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Completion Inspection and Fire Services Act certificate shall be obtained from the local fire and disaster prevention authority before commencement of production; if the factory floor area reaches 500 square meters or more, a civil defense shelter or evacuation plan must be approved by the local defense authority. Under the Occupational Safety and Health Act, the Company must submit a risk assessment report to the Korea Occupational Safety and Health Agency, obtain a structural load and electrical safety clearance for the assembly lines and battery storage area, and implement a workplace environment measurement plan before the first robot production run.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: National Tax Service (NTS) of the Republic of Korea; electronic portal: HomeTax (www.hometax.go.kr)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Non-resident entities seeking a Korean Tax Identification Number (TIN) must register for the Business Registration Certificate with the competent district tax office having jurisdiction over the Korean fixed place of business or the place of the tax representative. The procedure is: (1) appoint a Korean tax representative (Gukse-Gwalli-in) who is jointly liable; (2) file the Non-Resident Business Registration Application (Form 60-A) with the district NTS office or via HomeTax using an external representative; (3) submit supporting documents including the certificate of incorporation (apostilled or consularized), a resolution appointing the tax representative, and evidence of the Korean fixed business address; (4) obtain the 10-digit Business Registration Number (TIN), which simultaneously functions as the VAT ID; (5) register for e-Tax Invoice issuance through HomeTax. No minimum capital is required.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation. A Korean Yuhan Hoesa (LLC) is a domestic corporation under the Corporate Tax Act, and its global income is subject to corporate income tax. There is no transparent pass-through regime for a domestic LLC.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None. The Korea Corporate Tax Act does not provide a check-the-box entity classification election. Entity classification is statutory. Hybrid mismatch rules are addressed via specific anti-abuse provisions, but no elective tax classification is permitted.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: KRW 80,000,000 annual taxable supply turnover. However, non-residents with a Korean place of business or making any taxable supply in Korea must register from the date of business commencement regardless of turnover; persons without a fixed place of business may also be required to register through an authorized VAT agent.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Since July 1, 2021, e-tax invoices are mandatory for all VAT-registered businesses. Issuers must transmit invoice details to the HomeTax system within the day after issuance. There is no real-time fiscal clearance or digital stamping regime akin to Latin American customs; instead, electronic sales reports must be filed semi-annually, and the NTS uses an integrated audit trail system with pre-approval of invoice formats. General rule: same-day transmission to the NTS.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Article 21(1) of the VAT Act grants a 0% rate to the supply of goods that are exported, including goods placed into bonded areas, or if the goods are supplied to a non-resident and shipped from a bonded factory. For the AI pet robot hardware, the exporter must demonstrate: (a) the contract is with a non-resident; (b) the consideration is in foreign currency or a non-resident's local currency; (c) the goods are physically exported from Korea and a customs export declaration is filed; (d) after loading, the exporter receives the export price in the agreed currency. The goods must leave Korea generally within 6 months from date of export declaration, subject to extensions.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Bill of Lading or Airway Bill
Inward Remittance Certificate (FIRC) or foreign exchange bank transaction certificate
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: If the export is found not to have occurred or the proceeds are not repatriated within 180 days (without a valid extension from the Ministry of Strategy and Finance), the zero-rating is reversed, and the exporter must pay VAT at 10% on the export value, plus an additional tax of 10% of the evaded tax, and up to 40% under the fraudulent claim provisions of the Framework Act on National Taxes (Article 47-3), computed on the underpaid tax. Late filing and non-transmission of e-invoice penalties also apply. Claims may be audited retrospectively for five years.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Bank of Korea (Hanguk Eunhaeng), in conjunction with the Ministry of Economy and Finance as the foreign exchange policy authority under the Foreign Exchange Transactions Act
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Republic of Korea operates a liberalised but regulated convertibility regime. The won is fully convertible for current-account transactions, including trade settlements, service payments, and profit remittances or royalties, subject to mandatory reporting through the Foreign Exchange Information System (FERIS) under the Foreign Exchange Transactions Act. Capital-account transactions are broadly open, but certain inward foreign direct investment, securities dealing, and borrowing transactions require prior notification or application to the Bank of Korea or the Ministry of Economy and Finance. Foreign-invested companies are entitled to dividend remittances after settlement of corporate income tax and withholding tax; a tax withholding certificate and audited financial statements are normally required. The old physical surrender requirement for export proceeds is no longer in force; however, all export earnings must be settled and reported through a registered foreign exchange bank. Practical convertibility hurdles are procedural rather than structural and include purpose-code classification, submission of underlying evidence, and the mandate to complete settlement through a licensed domestic bank. Non-resident access to onshore KRW liquidity and forward markets is limited to firms with demonstrable, documented underlying exposure. No parallel-market subsidy or central-planning allocation exists, and the official onshore rate is market-determined. Overall credit and convertibility risk is low, but treasury operations must maintain strict FERIS reporting discipline to avoid administrative penalties.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: The statutory collection period for export proceeds is five years from the date of export, unless extended with Bank of Korea approval. There is no mandatory ratio requiring conversion of foreign currency export receipts into KRW. Exporters may retain foreign currency in a domestic foreign-currency account or convert to KRW at a registered foreign exchange bank, but every receipt must be captured in FERIS under the applicable export settlement transaction purpose code. Delayed collection, unusual partial receipts, or retention beyond the permissible cycle can trigger Korea Customs Service and Korea Financial Intelligence Unit review.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account and Basic Operating KRW Account
Capital Escrow Account and Basic Operating KRW Account
Capital Escrow Account and Basic Operating KRW Account
Capital Escrow Account and Basic Operating KRW Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low. Offshore financial-technology EMI platforms do not hold a Korean Banking Act license or Electronic Financial Transactions Act registration and are legally barred from providing onshore corporate operating accounts, receiving export proceeds, or acting as the bank of record for capital verification in Korea. A foreign EMI may only be used indirectly for e-commerce card acceptance through a licensed Korean payment gateway such as KG Inicis or Toss Payments, but it cannot serve as a treasury settlement rail for the Korean LLC. Therefore all statutory capital injections, operational cash-pooling, trade settlements, and FX transactions must be routed through a Tier-1 domestic commercial bank. Relying on an offshore EMI as a primary treasury channel would create a regulatory violation and expose the entity to anti-money-laundering chargebacks and frozen-funds risk.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: A statutory director or appointed corporate officer with a notarised and consular-apostilled power of attorney must appear in-branch at the selected Korean bank for the initial corporate account opening interview. Korean banks do not generally permit pure remote or consular proxy opening for new foreign-owned entities because they require the physical certification of the corporate seal impression, verification of original board resolutions, and direct in-person questioning under the Financial Transactions Reports Act. Where a foreign director is not present, a local representative can pursue opening only after the bank obtains prior approval from its anti-money-laundering compliance committee, with all corporate documents legalised and certified by the Korean consulate or apostille, and with a clear explanation of the remote opening exception.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident ownership structure with no domestically registered corporate seal or board resolution minute provided to the bank
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide the original and apostilled certificate of incorporation, full board resolution appointing the account signatory, corporate seal impression certificate (injeingaejeung), notarised power of attorney, passport copies of all directors, and a UBO declaration table covering every individual with 25% or more ownership

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Source of foreign initial paid-in capital cannot be verified through clean bank records
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Submit certified bank statements from the home-country account for at least 24 months, source-of-wealth declaration, audited financial statements or accountants report for the funding entity, signed share subscription agreement, tax filings supporting the origin of funds, and a written explanation of any large deposits entering the account prior to wiring

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: International sanctions, PEP, or adverse-media screening returns a match on a shareholder or director
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide individual screening reports from UN, EU, UK, OFAC, and Korean Financial Intelligence Unit lists, written analytical explanation for the true nature of any flag, PEP status declaration with verification of complete removal from official office where applicable, independent corporate background report, and a board resolution confirming no prohibited nexus

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Trade-flow mismatch between an AI pet robot manufacturer and expected cross-border settlement patterns
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Supply commercial contracts for component purchases, purchase orders and invoices, bill of lading or airway bill copies, Korean customs import/export declarations, warehouse inventory records, product technical specification sheets, and distribution or pre-order agreements proving the physical flow of goods and commercial substance

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound capital shall be routed by the non-resident shareholder via SWIFT MT103 to the dedicated foreign exchange bank account opened under the Foreign Investment Report filed with the Bank of Korea and Ministry of Economy and Finance under the Foreign Investment Promotion Act. The wire must be categorised on the flow-out side as direct investment capital subscription or capital increase under the FERIS statutory foreign exchange transaction purpose code for foreign direct investment. Upon receipt, the bank will convert to KRW at the prevailing market rate, issue a Foreign Exchange Bank Certificate of Inward Remittance and Capital Verification, and the company must complete the statutory paid-in capital registration in the Korean corporate registry. Dividends, loan repayments, and technical royalties can only be remitted outbound after clearance of the corporate income tax return, documentary evidence of withholding tax payment, and submission of audited financial statements to the remitting bank.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Routine component supplier payments will be executed through SWIFT MT103 with full invoice, packing list, and purchase order references, using the FERIS trade settlement purpose code for goods import. For higher-value assembly component procurement, use irrevocable documentary letters of credit opened through the Korean issuing bank, with negotiation against compliant documents at the foreign supplier's bank. For trusted medium-term counterparties, documentary collections on D/P or D/A terms are acceptable. Every outbound payment must be matched to a Korean customs import declaration prior to wire release. Stripe and credit-card sales from the interactive AI pet robot consumer channel must be settled through a licensed Korean payment gateway that remits KRW to the operating account; direct cross-border payouts from offshore payment aggregators are not permitted for local treasury purposes unless separately declared to the foreign exchange bank.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore KRW forward contracts for documented underlying trade receivables or payables
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) executed through approved international banks as a marginal hedge for offshore counterparties accessing KRW liquidity
FX options and zero-cost collars for conversion of export receipts into KRW in the official market
Cross-currency swaps for long-term alignment between foreign-denominated capital injections or borrowings and KRW operating cash flows

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax Return including financial statements and tax adjustment schedules
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: National Tax Service via HomeTax electronic filing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For December year-end, no later than March 31 of the following year; one-month automatic extension available where a certified tax agent prepares the return
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Unreported-tax penalty of 20% of unpaid corporate tax, per-day late-payment penalty of 0.022% for up to 9 months, tax seizure and forced collection; prolonged nonpayment may lead to business closure and court deregistration

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Local Corporate Income Tax Surcharge Return for municipal corporate taxes
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Local government tax authority of the registered municipality via Wetax common tax portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For December year-end, no later than April 30 of the following year; extended to May 31 when the underlying corporate tax return is extended
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late return penalty up to 20% of unpaid local income tax, per-day late-payment interest up to 9%; administrative seizure and strike-off of the business registration for gross and persistent default

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Statutory External Audit Report and attached audited financial statements
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Financial Supervisory Service through DART e-filing; court registry copy where disclosure obligation applies
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within three weeks after the annual members approval meeting, which for a December year-end must be held no later than March 31; effective audit filing deadline April 21 for non-extended cases
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fine up to KRW 40,000,000 and suspension or dismissal of the external auditor; repeated violation may trigger a criminal referral and corporate officer sanctions

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Foreign Invested Company Annual Report covering investment realization, shareholding changes, management status and business performance
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Korea Trade-Investment Promotion Agency under the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For December year-end, due not later than June 30 of the following year, or within three months after any different fiscal year-end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fine up to KRW 3,000,000 and loss of foreign investment support incentives; continued nonfiling may trigger a corrective order and unfavorable treatment in investment-related administrative matters

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Amending Commercial Registration for any change in members, directors, registered office, or business headquarters
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Competent Korean Commercial Registration Court at the headquarters location
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 14 days after the triggering event; for a routine organizational continuity review, confirmation is performed at the annual statutory compliance review point
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fine for late registration up to KRW 5,000,000; failure to keep register accurate can also obstruct legal contracts and result in judicial sanctions against directors

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit is triggered when the Korea-based entity meets or exceeds any of the following at fiscal year-end: total assets of KRW 120 billion, total revenue of KRW 100 billion, or 500 or more full-time employees; additional audit obligations apply to financial companies and other designated public-interest entities. A Yuhan Hoesa falling below these thresholds is exempt absent a member or creditor request.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Korean IFRS (K-IFRS) for companies subject to statutory external audit; Korean Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (K-GAAP) for non-audited smaller companies

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Korea does not maintain a public annual UBO declaration for domestic Yuhan Hoesa companies. Ownership changes are recorded through registrable shareholding transfers and reported in the Foreign Invested Company Annual Report when the entity is foreign-controlled. Shareholding and director variations require an amendment filing at the commercial registry within 14 days.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 24% top marginal rate; progressive rates at 9% on taxable income up to KRW 200 million, 19% on income between KRW 200 million and KRW 20 billion, 21% on income between KRW 20 billion and KRW 300 billion, and 24% on income above KRW 300 billion
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No general statutory tax holiday; effective rate is reduced through targeted incentives under the Restriction of Special Taxation Act, including R&D tax credits, facility investment credits, job creation credits, venture/SME income tax reductions, and free economic zone incentives under the Foreign Investment Promotion Act

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Final Corporate Income Tax Return (Corporate Tax Base and Tax Computation Return, Form 1) filed through the National Tax Service HomeTax electronic portal at www.hometax.go.kr
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Filed no later than the last day of the third month following the close of the fiscal year; for a December 31 fiscal year-end the due date is March 31, and for a non-calendar fiscal year-end the due date is correspondingly shifted

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross revenue from sale of interactive AI pet robot hardware, accessories, embedded software, cloud subscription services, and repair services
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report all Korean-source revenue; export sales must be separately disclosed with shipping and title transfer evidence and translated to KRW using the Bank of Korea trading base rate at the fiscal year-end

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Cost of sales comprising direct materials, imported components, third-party assembly, manufacturing labor, warranty reserves, and inbound freight
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach the cost of sales schedule in KRW; intercompany purchases must be supported by contemporaneous transfer pricing documentation if the counterparty is a foreign related party

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross profit or gross loss automatically derived from revenue less cost of sales
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a non-resident without a Korean permanent establishment, no final corporate return is generally required; the withholding agent report remains the filing obligation

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Selling, general and administrative expenses such as marketing, cloud hosting, personnel costs, office rent, depreciation, insurance, and legal/professional fees
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Expenses must be connected to Korean-source business and specifically evidenced; overhead allocations must follow the arm's length and benefit test

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Operating income before non-operating items, computed as gross profit less selling, general and administrative expenses
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Losses from non-Korean operations may not be commingled unless the taxpayer is a resident corporation or PE under Article 60 of the Corporate Tax Act

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Non-operating revenue and non-operating expenses including interest income, foreign exchange gains or losses, asset disposal gains or losses, and impairment charges
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report only Korean-source non-operating items in the domestic return; cross-border interest and royalties are subject to separate withholding if paid to non-residents

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Ordinary income before tax adjustments, equal to operating income plus non-operating revenue less non-operating expense
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If the non-resident has treaty protection and no PE, no final return is filed; income sourced through a dependent agent in Korea must be returned here

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income adjustments including disallowed expenses, non-deductible entertainment expenses, depreciation differences, unrealized gains, and tax-exempt income
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach each adjustment schedule; intercompany management fees must satisfy the arm's length standard and Korean source documentation rules

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income before loss carryforward, as adjusted by taxable income adjustments
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A non-resident PE must compute Korean taxable income separately under the force of attraction rules; treaty-protected business profits are excluded only if no PE exists

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Carryforward net operating loss deduction within the statutory ten-year limit
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach loss carryforward schedules; losses from a foreign corporation without Korean source connection cannot be offset against Korean PE income

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Final taxable income, tax base, and income tax calculated using the progressive corporate income tax rates
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Apply the same progressive rates to Korean-source taxable income of a PE as to a domestic corporation; no separate branch rate exists

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax credits, interim prepayments, withheld taxes, and final corporate income tax due or refundable
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If the company has a Korean PE, offsets are allowed for interim prepayments; non-residents receiving dividends, interest, or royalties file only withholding returns

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing triggers an additional tax of 20% of the unpaid corporate income tax; failure to attach required schedules attracts additional schedule-based penalties; unpaid tax accrues daily late-payment interest at the statutory rate of 0.022% per day, and fraudulent filing carries criminal prosecution under the Punishment Act for Tax Evasion

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Interim Tax Prepayment Return (Corporate Income Tax Interim Prepayment Return) filed through HomeTax under Article 63 of the Corporate Tax Act
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Semi-annual interim prepayment; settled at the annual final return
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Filed within two months after the close of the first six months of the taxable year; for a December year-end company, the interim return is due by August 31

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Interim taxable income computed using the preceding year's taxable income divided by two, or actual taxable income for the first six months
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A non-resident with a Korean PE must file the interim prepayment based on actual six-month profits; if no PE is present, the interim return is generally not required

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Provisional corporate income tax calculated at the same progressive rates, after taking interim deductions
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach a simple profit and loss statement for the first half if using the actual-income method; the statutory estimation method may not be used when accounting records permit actual computation

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Prepayment due, reduced by prior interim prepayments and any available credits
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Any deficiency in the interim prepayment carries the same additional tax and daily late-payment interest as the annual return

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to file the interim prepayment return or pay the interim tax triggers an additional tax of 20% of the unpaid interim amount plus daily late-payment interest at 0.022% per day; repeated failure can accelerate the National Tax Service's assessment cycle
